page.title: KERI Foundation Videos
page.heading: KERI Foundation Videos
page.subtitle: Recorded conferences, talks, and sessions from the KERI Foundation
page.introduction: Videos from KERI conferences, SEDI summits, and other sessions — from Samuel Smith’s introductions and keynotes to community talks and interviews on witnesses, wallets, ACDCs, did:webs, and Utah’s state-endorsed identity work, plus Veridian wallet demos. Each gallery has curated subtitles, searchable transcripts, and tools for creating clips.
